signal_definitions.idx_vol: sqrt(mean r_index^2) over the last 22 trading days (data <= t)
signal_definitions.avg_vol: cross-sectional mean of constituent 22d realized vols (PIT basket on t)
signal_definitions.rdisp: avg_vol / idx_vol  (PRIMARY; scale-free, decreasing in average correlation)
signal_definitions.rho: equal-weighted average pairwise realized correlation implied by the EW portfolio variance
signal_definitions.csvd: cross-sectional stdev of constituent vols (the sector-level measure of K415/K982, now at constituent level)

design.target: forward average daily variance over t+1..t+h (h=1 -> r_{t+1}^2); forward 22d max drawdown for the tail leg
design.baseline: log-HAR (l_rv_d, l_rv_w, l_rv_m); also RW(22d) and AR(1); identical lag convention and identical log-normal smearing for every model
design.test: paired fixed-756-observation rolling OOS, forward-label embargo j+h<i, Giacomini-White (2006) equal unconditional predictive ability on QLIKE
design.primary_family: 2 assets x 3 horizons, nested HAR vs HAR+rdisp, Patton QLIKE loss, BH FDR across six two-sided GW p-values
design.gate: QLIKE improvement > 0 AND GW z < -3 AND BH q < 0.05
design.bounded_null_gate: pre-specified 1% relative QLIKE material-gain exclusion; all six one-sided GW tests must reject after Holm adjustment
design.raw_dm_role: diagnostic-only; never feeds a nested-model verdict

material_gain_exclusion.scope: rules out a material gain; does not prove exact equality

primary_verdict.claim: The formal test can establish superior predictive ability, but failure to reject equal QLIKE accuracy is not proof of exact equivalence.

dispersion_after_level_verdict.note: This is an MSE-only incremental-content family: Clark-West, MSE point estimates, and BH-FDR jointly govern the gate. QLIKE and raw DM are descriptive here and do not feed the verdict.
